description: Your verification programs, as a vendor: phase, public status (Claim confirmed · within 5.0 points, Claim not confirmed, Lapsed or Revoked, or private), the one next step, every step from setup to a published score that is not done yet (yours to do, waiting on a customer or on Attify, or locked and by what), each publishing minimum met or missing in your own numbers, what the latest score still waits for before it publishes, the claimed unit as Attify recorded it, and your customers' connection and consent. It states where the program stands; it never advises how to raise a score. Needs sign-in to Attify; reads only.
